purpose: Name the precise missing inputs and failed screens at three hard structural stations before assigning a connector architecture.
existing_two_wood_member_yield_method: fea/dowel_yield.py; applicable only after an actual two-member single-shear detail and its bearing lengths, grain angles, shank and Fyb are defined
archived_wrench_limit: Each a12-left force/moment pair is one illustrative simultaneous beam-flange example at its archived station origin, not prioritization evidence, a historical peak envelope, or new-candidate demand. The separately listed historical force and moment norm maxima may occur in different cases: never combine them into a synthetic wrench, shift an old moment to current geometry, or use any archived value as a new-candidate demand or capacity claim.
separate_historical_peak_source: docs/bolted-candidate-prototypes/representative-historical-demands.json; verified against docs/floor-runner-mvp-angle-demands.json (SHA-256 5446aeacaccafb70c77358635e5fb84c1b9627eb922209411b748e5e34c9e558); separate beam-flange norm maxima must not be paired

narrow_opposing.failed_trial_only: A centered 3/8-inch A66 bolt on a 38.1-mm narrow timber face has -19.05-mm 4D loaded-edge reserve under reversible perpendicular-to-grain loading. A broad-face arrangement remains untested, not rejected by this screen.
missing_inputs: verified factory bolt-hole coordinates and flange pose on a usable broad face
actual two-member or steel-to-wood bearing lengths, grain/load directions and bolt thread position
supported washer/nut stack and full tool/bolt withdrawal corridor beside frozen panel axes
new-candidate simultaneous local wrench and defensible flange contact/prying distribution
A66 steel thickness/grade/bend and hole-bearing resistance if A66 remains proposed
narrow_opposing.next_action: Find a manufacturer dimensioned A66 drawing or switch to another in-scope connector/detail, then perform exact broad-face solid and washer/tool-envelope fit before resistance calculations.

archived_same_case_wrench.reference: archived beam-flange origin at y=-135 mm; current clip is at y=-124.9 mm

missing_inputs: actual connector bolt-hole pattern and bolt axes at the moved current station
interference with neighboring center-header hardware, retained 20 panel/kicker axes and proposed outward support shift
actual exit face, supported washer/nut stack, tool access and extraction path
current-geometry and new-candidate simultaneous local wrench; old moment cannot be copied or shifted as a new solve
wood grain and net-section/group failure path plus steel-angle bending/prying basis
center_header.next_action: Select an in-scope detail and exact current-position geometry, test both center stations and retained panel axes, then recover fresh affected actions before a capacity decision.
center_header.ab205_trial: docs/bolted-candidate-prototypes/ab205-center-fit.json: long-vertical-leg nominal hole row at old clip Y misses conditional reversible 4D far-principal edge by 29.073 mm; shifting Y yields only a 0.148-mm nominal common 4D band. Short-vertical-leg orientation widens that band to 9.774 mm but has a 26.940-mm grain ray to the oblique end. End distance is not classified for either.

archived_same_case_wrench.reference: archived beam-flange origin; nominal station location unchanged

missing_inputs: verified factory bolt-hole coordinates, flange pose and actual exit faces
solid clearance from the two retained nearby front-runner bolt stacks, lower rim cut, runner and floor/pad envelope
supported washer/nut, socket and bolt extraction corridors without moving panel screws
new-candidate simultaneous wrench and local bolt-group/contact force distribution
actual wood splitting/net-section and connector steel hole/bend/prying resistance
outer_base.next_action: Fit the selected connector against the real rim/header solids and retained front-bolt stacks, then calculate the complete joint path with fresh candidate actions.

common_unresolved_product_input: The current US Simpson A66 catalog specifies two 3/8-inch bolts per leg but gives no F1/F2 allowable load or verified dimensioned factory centers. ABB AB205 supplies nominal dimensions but no guaranteed steel strength and its published 2,000-lb strut-channel load does not transfer to wood. Newhouse BR904 names Q235 steel and hole pitch but lacks complete product-specific dimensions, strength guarantee, and a wood rating. No retail lead has a demonstrated fit and whole-joint resistance at these three stations.
